issue.title: Session turns whose runner died without a recorded pid stay RUNNING on the Agents tab
issue.description:
Proposed by phase sase-1ux.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1) of epic sase-1ux, filed by the
sase-1ux land agent. The epic plan asked held-state to confirm or rule out, without
fixing, that a session agent turn whose runner died stays RUNNING on the Agents tab.

Audit result recorded by sase-1ux.2 against `_agent_loader_normalization.py`
(`_filter_dead_pids`) and `_compact_workflow_loaders.py` (dead-pid gate):

- Agent-kind session members with a recorded dead pid are dropped (`_filter_dead_pids`)
  or marked FAILED (workflow loaders). Ruled out for the common case.
- Agent-kind session members with `pid=None` stay RUNNING: the dead-pid gate never
  fires because there is no pid to probe.
- Monitor and gate session members are exempt from the gate because they inherit the
  starter's pid; with a dead inherited pid they keep their projected status. For an
  unheld `staged` monitor that is a phantom RUNNING until staged reconcile marks it held.

This is the same phantom-RUNNING class epic sase-1ux removed for held stages; the epic
left these two pid-less / inherited-pid paths unchanged by design.

task_type_fields.impact: A dead session turn reads RUNNING in the row, BY_STATUS, and count chips, hiding a stuck clan the same way incident tailnet-1e.6.1.8 did.
task_type_fields.repro:
Create a session agent-turn member artifact dir (agent kind, no `pid` in agent_meta.json,
no done.json, workflow_state running) whose runner process is gone, then load the Agents
tab model (both the scan-wire and filesystem loaders). The row projects RUNNING with a
ticking clock indefinitely. Second shape: a `staged` monitor member without
`monitor_stage_held` whose inherited starter pid is dead, before staged reconcile runs.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1ux's held-state phase audited the dead-pid gate as the plan required and found pid-less agent turns and inherited-pid monitor/gate members still project RUNNING after their runner dies; the epic deliberately left this unfixed.

payload.description: Monitor-side analog: a pid-less proc-backed running monitor is never reconciled; same pid=None blind spot
